key_insight: Current multimodal LLMs show uneven scientific visualization literacy: Gemini leads overall, but capabilities vary sharply by visualization technique and task.
engineering_relevance: SciVis literacy should be treated as a distinct benchmark for selecting, validating, and deploying multimodal AI in scientific analysis workflows.
method: Benchmarked six MLLMs: three closed-source and three open-source.
Used a standardized 49-item scientific visualization literacy assessment spanning 18 visualizations, 8 techniques, and 11 task types.
Compared model performance against responses from 485 human participants under a closed-world protocol.
evidence_signal: The evaluation used 49 items across 18 SciVis examples and showed Gemini above the human mean on evaluated subsets, while open-source models stayed below the human baseline.
watch_item: Results come from a closed-world benchmark, so real-world performance may differ when models face unseen visualization styles or interactive analysis settings.
paper_title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
